## UpdateDispatcher class

Worker pool that drains a bounded queue through a per-key gate.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class UpdateDispatcher 
```

## Remarks

Replaces the fire-and-forget loop in `Gramstax._startWebhookWorker`<!-- -->. Unlike that loop it stores its worker promises so `stop()` can join them, wraps the whole iteration in `try/catch` so one throw cannot silently shrink the pool, and reports the residual count instead of abandoning updates without a trace.
